syllabus_basis: The GPAT 2026 bulletin states that the syllabus comprises subject/knowledge areas as per The Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) Course Regulations, 2024.
important_version_rule: Do not silently substitute the newer B.Pharm 2026 NEP syllabus for the GPAT 2026 syllabus basis. Keep GPAT versions separately versioned and update only when the competent authority publishes a new basis.
content_policy: Use official examination documents as the authority. Third-party topic lists may assist discovery but are not treated as authoritative without official confirmation.
